pin_label.label: Qualitative Coding's October 2026 theory (run e131eb55), not its published run
pin_label.reason: Qualitative Coding's status page names a later run, a67d7d6a (2026-11-05), as published and says that theory is being revised. It has committed neither that theory nor the revision, so this page reads the newest Open Science theory it has committed with its cited passages: run e131eb55, from 2026-10-09. By Qualitative Coding's own measure that run is not finished: it rejects 46% of proposed quotes, above its 'wrong if' line of roughly a quarter (the published run rejects 11.7%), and it predates its disprove test. Qualitative Coding has been asked to commit its current theory as a file (issue #205 in its repository).
pin_label.repin_when: When Qualitative Coding commits the newer theory in its own repository, this pin moves to it and every figure built on the theory is recomputed (Plan #8, open question Q26).
